description: Section header with a live slide counter and inline previous/next controls.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ClockIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, CarouselNext, CarouselPrevious, type CarouselApi, } from "@workspace/ui/components/carousel" const guides = [ { title: "Set up your first workspace", minutes: 4 }, { title: "Invite teammates and assign roles", minutes: 3 }, { title: "Connect your calendar", minutes: 2 }, { title: "Build an automation", minutes: 6 }, { title: "Share a public dashboard", minutes: 5 }, { title: "Export data to CSV", minutes: 2 }, ] export default function SlideCounterHeader() { const [state, setState] = React.useState({ current: 1, count: 0 }) const handleApi = React.useCallback((api: CarouselApi) => { if (!api) return const update = () => setState({ current: api.selectedScrollSnap() + 1, count: api.scrollSnapList().length, }) update() api.on("select", update).on("reInit", update) }, []) return (

Getting started guides

{state.current} / {state.count}

{guides.map((guide, index) => (
Guide {index + 1} {guide.title} {guide.minutes} min read
))} ) }
